rationale: Freeze deterministic UTF-8 path-only bytes, optional trailing LF, and prefix behavior for Kotlin and C#.

cases.name: empty
cases.rationale: Empty input always emits zero bytes.

cases.name: canonical
cases.rationale: Order and duplicates are retained with LF and trailing LF.

cases.name: trim-and-slashes
cases.rationale: Records are trimmed and backslashes become forward slashes.

cases.name: no-trailing-newline
cases.rationale: The optional trailing newline can be disabled.

cases.name: prefix-and-already-prefixed
cases.rationale: Prefix is normalized once and detected case-insensitively.
